title: Return free maps factor through the original equivariant map
statement: Let \(k_0,k_1\) be finite fields, \(l\) a prime different from both characteristics, \(X/k_0\) and \(C/k_1\) schemes, and \(r\in\mathbf N\). Let \(\bar X,\bar C\) denote their geometric fibers over the chosen algebraic closures, with geometric Galois Frobenius \(\operatorname{Fr}_X,\operatorname{Fr}_C\). Suppose \(v:\bar C\to\bar X\) is an open immersion and \(v\circ\operatorname{Fr}_C=\operatorname{Fr}_X^r\circ v\). For pro-etale adic Weil sheaves \(V\) on \(X\) and \(G\) on \(C\), let \(i:G\to P_{\rm all}(V)\) be a Weil morphism for the explicit powered pullback and carrier comparison of [def-zl-powered-pullback-carrier]. Let \(s:G_{\rm car}\to v^*V_{\rm car}\) be its carrier map under this comparison, and \(t:v_!G_{\rm car}\to V_{\rm car}\) its adjoint. For every \(m\in\mathbf Z\), there exists \(a:v^*\operatorname{Free.obj}(F,v_!G_{\rm car},rm)\to G_{\rm car}\) with \(v^*\operatorname{Free.hom}(V,t,rm)=s\circ a\), where \(F=(\operatorname{Fr}_X^{-1})_*\) and the actual free maps are those of [def-zl-frobenius-saturation]. No model monomorphism or constant-field cardinality equation is assumed.

proof.text: Construct an isomorphism from the rth Frobenius pullback of the nth free summand to the (n+r)th summand. Induction on r, pushforward composition and the free-algebra shift equation show that this isomorphism intertwines the coprojections and the rth Weil structure.

proof.text: Transport this identity through the commuting comparison for powered pullback. The pulled-back free map is equivariant. If the nth restricted summand factors through i, equivariance of i gives a factorization for n+r, conjugating by the shift isomorphism and the invertible structure of G. Full faithfulness of Frobenius and the inverse structure give the converse.

theorem clopen_return_freeHom_factor
    {k₀ k₁ : Type u} [Field k₀] [Finite k₀] [Field k₁] [Finite k₁]
    {l : ℕ} [Fact l.Prime]
    [Fact (ringChar k₀ ≠ l)] [Fact (ringChar k₁ ≠ l)]
    {X C : Scheme.{u}} [X.Over (Spec (.of k₀))] [C.Over (Spec (.of k₁))]
    (v : (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricFiber ⟶ (X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricFiber)
    [IsOpenImmersion v] (r : ℕ)
    (hv : (C ↘ Spec (.of k₁)).geometricGaloisFrobenius.hom ≫ v =
      v ≫ ((X ↘ Spec (.of k₀)).geometricGaloisFrobenius ^ r).hom)
    (V : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₀ l X) (G : ProEtaleWeilSheaf k₁ l C)
    (i : G ⟶ (poweredGeometricPullbackAll v r hv).obj V) (m : ℤ) :
    ∃ a : (v)^*ᵃ[l].obj
        (IsoAlgebra.Free.obj (frobeniusPullback k₀ l X) ((v)_!ᵃ[l].obj G.carrier)
          ((r : ℤ) * m)) ⟶ G.carrier,
      (v)^*ᵃ[l].map
          (IsoAlgebra.Free.hom V
            (((ProEtale.adicOpenImmersionLowerShriekAdjunction l v).homEquiv
              G.carrier V.carrier).symm
                (i.hom.f ≫ (poweredPullbackAllCarrierIso v r hv).hom.app V))
            ((r : ℤ) * m)) =
        a ≫ i.hom.f ≫ (poweredPullbackAllCarrierIso v r hv).hom.app V
